title: transcode.job.create payload (command)
description: Command issued by BMS/RIM to MTS to enqueue a transcode job. Answered by transcode.completed or transcode.failed under the command's own correlationId — a well-formed command MTS cannot honour (an unknown preset, an input it cannot read) is answered transcode.failed at once (EP-22.4), so the issuer never waits on a job that was never queued.

inputPath.description: A file under MTS's work root. Exactly one of inputPath and inputFile.

inputFile.description: The asset's file in HSM, fetched by MTS at run time (EP-14.7) — how BMS names an input (EP-22.4). Exactly one of inputPath and inputFile.
